text:
Maya: CI alert: flaky failure in ci-linux-x86-serve-58 on `retry_backoff_test`
Maya: Failure sample from the run:
```
thread 'serve::retry::policy_test::retry_backoff_test' panicked at 'expected order [100, 200, 400], got [100, 400, 200]', tests/retry_policy.rs:79
```
Maya: Job: https://ci.internal.redwood/ci-linux-x86-serve-58 (full logs attached)
Sam: Ugh. Can someone kick a rerun and if it repros, start a bisect? I can help later with the bisect.
ci-bot: Rerun scheduled by @Sam for job ci-linux-x86-serve-58. Rerun id: rerun-9911.
Liam: Looks like the test spawns three retry tasks with jitter from thread_rng. On linux the scheduler sometimes yields so two tasks can finish with identical ms timestamps and ordering flips. Non-deterministic scheduling + real time = flaky.
Nora: We have tests/util::FakeClock that other suites use. Short term fix: switch test to FakeClock and deterministic RNG seed. Long term: avoid asserting strict ordering when deltas can be equal.
Maya: Rerun-9911 completed: 2/4 runs showed the failure. Repro rate ~50% locally on CI. Trace shows two events with same timestamp rounding.
Ash: I'll take ownership. Plan: (1) small PR to replace real clock with FakeClock in retry tests, (2) set rand seed for jitter so ordering is deterministic, (3) add a clarification comment and an extra assertion that tolerates equal-delta ties but checks relative spawn ids.
Ash: Before I change, quick grep for other tests using wall-clock ordering. Liam, can you paste grep results?
Liam: `git grep -n "Instant::now\(|Duration::from_millis\(|thread_rng()` tests/` -> found 9 hits across retry, heartbeat, session tests.
Sam: If PR is tiny, we can run a local stress run (1000 iterations) before merging. I can run that on my machine.
ci-bot: Tip: to run automated bisect: `ci bisect --job ci-linux-x86-serve-58 --test retry_backoff_test`
Maya: Thanks. Ash, tag @Sam and me on the PR. If flakiness persists after the PR, we'll bisect across seeds and shards. :thumbsup:
Ash: Draft PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serve-runtime/pull/4850 - includes FakeClock + seeded jitter + extra tie-handling assertion. Running local stress (200 iterations) now.
Sam: Ping once you have stress results, I'll queue a longer run.
Maya: Appreciated. Keeping this thread for follow-ups and bisect status.
